resolution.note: regression test in test/task/pending-records.test.ts fails on base, passes with fix; closing a pending record keeps it on the pending ref, publish --dry-run lists it, git status empty

title: Closing a pending task leaves an untracked record that publish skips
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: t-wtzyamw was created with krn task create (held on refs/krn/pending-tasks); krn task close t-wtzyamw in the main checkout then wrote an untracked tasks/t-wtzyamw.json and removed it from the pending set, so krn task publish (aa89551) did not ship it.
Outcome: closing a pending task keeps the closed record in the pending set; publish ships it; the main checkout stays clean (git status prints nothing).
Proof: a regression test creates, closes and publishes --dry-run one task and asserts the id is listed and git status is empty.
